requirements.principalText: Successful drawer actions are truthful and silent.
requirements.precondition: authorized office; cabinet transition changes state
requirements.expectedObservation: drawer remains unchanged before hand contact, changes at its registered contact, and completes without dialogue

requirements.precondition: active PICK UP, USE, OPEN, CLOSE, PUSH, or PULL world route
requirements.expectedObservation: runtime selects the typed pose, contact, mutation, and post-contact speech owners

requirements.principalText: Correct shared window geometry and overlap priority.
requirements.expectedObservation: window begins three pixels after the furthest cabinet and ends at the stanchion midpoint while stanchion wins overlap

requirements.principalText: Full-delivery speech measurement and edge clamping.
requirements.precondition: speaker-attached blocking or nonblocking delivery at an edge
requirements.expectedObservation: one-character, half, and full reveal share a full-text width and remain within the logical margin after resize and font readiness

requirements.precondition: focused runtime and browser observations completed for the candidate
requirements.expectedObservation: each status derives from its own bound observation and all twelve isolated mutations fail semantically

requirements.principalText: Complete, backward-compatible script and interaction export.
requirements.precondition: prior v1.0 review package and current production owners available
requirements.expectedObservation: every prior delivery ID maps to itself and complete stateful hotspot and inventory registers have owners and results

requirements.precondition: one direct candidate commit and all required evidence finalized
requirements.expectedObservation: self-verifier reconstructs the exact candidate tree and validates final bundle, patch, manifest, and final ZIP measurements

mutations.description: restore nothing-to-open dialogue on successful miscellaneous drawer open
restore nothing-to-close dialogue on successful case drawer close
remove lamp empty-hand contact while retaining labels
mutate drawer state before semantic contact
select paper reach for ordinary drawer action
move window left across cabinet while expected strings survive elsewhere
lower stanchion priority below window overlap
measure current revealed substring instead of full delivery
remove font, scale, or speaker movement recomputation
omit one dynamic script owner while retaining R55 source
classify a reachable dynamic route as dormant
derive PASS from an unbound broad suite boolean
